title: cornus elliptica
intro: Cornus elliptica, commonly known as Tatarian Dogwood or Korean Cornel, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cornaceae. This shrub is valued for its medicinal properties, and it is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and inflammation. The health benefits of Cornus elliptica include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in Cornus elliptica include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
